            <div class="postBody">

        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202602/381412-20260225172927811-936310258.png" alt="MAF快速入门（17）用户智能体交互协议AG-UI（中）" class="desc_img">
        本文介绍了AG-UI Tools即AG-UI的工具系统，演示了一个结合前后端工具使用的混合模式案例，通过案例可以了解如何在AG-UI中调用工具并观察调用链。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span><span>大家好，我是Edison。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>最近我一直在跟着圣杰的《<span>.NET+AI智能体开发进阶<span>》课程学习MAF开发多智能体工作流，我强烈推荐你也上车跟我一起出发！</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/edisontalk/p/-/quick-start-on-maf-chatper16" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2"><span>上一篇</span></a><span>，我们初步学习了AG-UI<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: justify;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 15px;letter-spacing: 0.544px;text-align: left;caret-color: var(--weui-BRAND);&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>。本篇，我们来了解AG-UI Tools 以及 实现一个前后端工具混合使用的案例。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h1><strong>1 什么是AG-UI Tools？</strong></h1>
<p><span><span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: justify;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 15px;letter-spacing: 0.544px;text-align: left;caret-color: var(--weui-BRAND);&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>AG-UI Tools 是 AG-UI 的 工具系统，分为 Backend Tools 和 Frontend Tools，它们是AI Agent和外部世界交互的桥梁，让AI Agent能够执行实际操作，而不仅仅是生成文本<span><span>。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3><span><span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: justify;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 15px;letter-spacing: 0.544px;text-align: left;caret-color: var(--weui-BRAND);&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span><span><span>Backend Tools</span></span></span></span></span></span></h3>
<p><span><span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: justify;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 15px;letter-spacing: 0.544px;text-align: left;caret-color: var(--weui-BRAND);&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span><span><span>顾名思义，</span></span></span></span></span></span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: justify;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 15px;letter-spacing: 0.544px;text-align: left;caret-color: var(--weui-BRAND);&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">Backend Tools即后端工具，它在服务端执行，主要用于做一些类似数据库查询、API调用 或 敏感操作等用途，主要访问服务端资源，安全性要求较高。</span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: justify;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 15px;letter-spacing: 0.544px;text-align: left;caret-color: var(--weui-BRAND);&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">何时需要使用Backend Tools？</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span>🔐 涉及敏感数据或 API 密钥</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>💾 需要访问数据库或后端服务</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>⚡ 计算密集型任务</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>🔒 需要服务端验证和审计</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span><span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: justify;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 15px;letter-spacing: 0.544px;text-align: left;caret-color: var(--weui-BRAND);&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span><span><span>Frontend Tools</span></span></span></span></span></span></h3>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: justify;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 15px;letter-spacing: 0.544px;text-align: left;caret-color: var(--weui-BRAND);&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">顾名思义，Frontend Tools即前端工具，它在客户端执行，主要用于做一些类似GPS定位、剪贴板 或者 设备传感器等用途，主要访问客户端设备资源，安全性上仅需做客户端验证。</span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: justify;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 15px;letter-spacing: 0.544px;text-align: left;caret-color: var(--weui-BRAND);&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">何时需要使用Frontend Tools？</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span>📍 需要访问设备功能（GPS、相机等）</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>📋 需要读取本地资源（剪贴板、文件）</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>🔑 涉及用户隐私数据</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>⚡ 需要快速响应的本地操作</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h1><strong><span>2 快速开始：前后端工具混合使用<strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;6 3 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;outline: 0px;visibility: visible;line-height: 1.75em;margin-top: 16px;margin-bottom: 16px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;color: rgb(0, 179, 139);font-family: \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Lantinghei SC\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft Yahei\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft Sans Serif\&quot;, \&quot;WenQuanYi Micro Hei\&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.544px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><br></span></strong></span></strong></h1>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">假设我们有这样一个需求：我们向Agent询问“附近有什么好吃的餐厅”，AG-UI前端会使用前端工具获取当前定位信息，然后将问题和定位发给AG-UI服务端，服务端又调用服务端工具搜索附近的餐馆信息，最后由大模型整合结果输出最终信息。</p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">整个调用流程如下图所示：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202602/381412-20260225172225128-1957872183.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">接下来，我们就一步一步完成一个AG-UI Tools示例应用涉及到的Server 和 Client。</p>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><strong><span><span>AG-UI Tools Server</span></span></strong></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">首先，我们创建一个ASP.NET Web应用，安装以下NuGet包：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Microsoft.Agents.AI.Hosting.AGUI.AspNetCore
Microsoft.Agents.AI.OpenAI
Microsoft.Extensions.AI.OpenAI</pre>
</div>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">然后，就是整个示例的核心部分，我们一块一块来说：</p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><strong>（1）定义相关数据模型</strong></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>说明：这里配置 JsonSerializerContext （JSON源生成器）主要用以提高序列化性能，确保在Native AOT环境下也能够正常序列化，即AOT友好。</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 📦 数据模型定义

<p><strong><span><span>（3）创建应用并注册AG-UI服务</span></span></strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Step0. Create WebApplication builder</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> builder =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);
builder.Services.AddHttpClient().AddLogging();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ⭐ 配置 JSON 序列化上下文 (用于数据模型的序列化)</span>
builder.Services.ConfigureHttpJsonOptions(options =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    options.SerializerOptions.TypeInfoResolverChain.Add(MixedToolsJsonContext.Default));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Step1. Register AG-UI services</span>

    .AsAIAgent(
        name: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MixedToolsAssistant</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    instructions: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        你是一个智能餐厅推荐助手，具备以下能力：

        🌍 位置感知：
        </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 可以获取用户的当前位置（使用 GetUserLocation 工具）
        </span>- 当用户说<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">附近</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>、<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">周围</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">时，先获取位置

        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 如果用户想了解某家餐厅，调用 GetRestaurantDetail

        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">,</span>

    tools: frontendTools);  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 👈 注册前端工具</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;clear: both;min-height: 1em;color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);font-family: \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.578px;orphans: 2;text-align: left;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;white-space: normal;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;line-height: 1.75em;visibility: visible;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);margin: 0px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;visibility: visible;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">最后，准备开始对话：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Step4. Prepare for Conversation</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> session = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> agent.GetNewSessionAsync();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> messages = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;ChatMessage&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">()
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ChatMessage(ChatRole.System, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        你是一个智能餐厅推荐助手。
        你可以使用多种工具来帮助用户找到合适的餐厅。
        当用户问</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">附近有什么餐厅</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">时，先获取他们的位置，再搜索餐厅。
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">)</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">};

Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">💬 开始对话（输入 :q 或 quit 退出）\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
{
    Console.Write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">👤 用户: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? message =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Console.ReadLine();

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message))
    {
        Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">⚠️ 消息不能为空，请重新输入。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (message <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">:q</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> or <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">quit</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n👋 再见！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }


    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加用户消息</span>
    messages.Add(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatMessage(ChatRole.User, message));

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 统计工具调用</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> frontendToolCalls = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> backendToolCalls = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> isFirstUpdate = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    List</span>&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt; toolCallChain =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [];

    Console.WriteLine();
    Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 开始处理 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 流式接收响应</span>
    Console.Write(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🤖 助手: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> update <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> agent.RunStreamingAsync(messages, session))
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> chatUpdate =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> update.AsChatResponseUpdate();

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (isFirstUpdate)
        {
            Console.ForegroundColor </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConsoleColor.DarkGray;
            Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[🔄 Run Started - Thread: {chatUpdate.ConversationId?.Substring(0, 8)}...]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            Console.ResetColor();
            isFirstUpdate </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (AIContent content <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> update.Contents)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (content)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TextContent textContent:
                    Console.ForegroundColor </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConsoleColor.Cyan;
                    Console.Write(textContent.Text);
                    Console.ResetColor();
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FunctionCallContent functionCall:
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 判断是前端还是后端工具</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> isFrontendTool = frontendTools.Any(t =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                        t.Name </span>==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> functionCall.Name);

                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (isFrontendTool)
                    {
                        frontendToolCalls</span>++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                        Console.ForegroundColor </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConsoleColor.Magenta;
                        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n📱 [前端工具调用] {functionCall.Name}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                    }
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                    {
                        backendToolCalls</span>++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                        Console.ForegroundColor </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConsoleColor.Yellow;
                        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n🖥️ [后端工具调用] {functionCall.Name}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 显示后端工具参数</span>
                        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (functionCall.Arguments != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                        {
                            Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">   📝 参数:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> kvp <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> functionCall.Arguments)
                            {
                                Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">      • {kvp.Key}: {kvp.Value}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Console.ResetColor();

                    toolCallChain.Add(isFrontendTool </span>? $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">📱{functionCall.Name}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> : $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🖥️{functionCall.Name}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FunctionResultContent functionResult:
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 后端工具结果显示</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!frontendTools.Any(t =&gt; toolCallChain.LastOrDefault()?.Contains(t.Name) ?? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
                    {
                        Console.ForegroundColor </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConsoleColor.Green;
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> resultPreview = functionResult.Result?.ToString() ?? <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (resultPreview.Length &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">150</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                        {
                            resultPreview </span>= resultPreview.Substring(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">150</span>) + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                        }
                        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">   ✅ 结果: {resultPreview}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                        Console.ResetColor();
                    }
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ErrorContent errorContent:
                    Console.ForegroundColor </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConsoleColor.Red;
                    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n❌ 错误: {errorContent.Message}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                    Console.ResetColor();
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }
        }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 显示工具调用链</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    Console.WriteLine();
    Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 处理完成 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.ForegroundColor </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConsoleColor.DarkGray;
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[✅ Run Finished]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">   📱 前端工具调用: {frontendToolCalls}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">   🖥️ 后端工具调用: {backendToolCalls}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (toolCallChain.Count &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">   🔗 调用链: {string.Join(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> → <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">, toolCallChain)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }

    Console.ResetColor();
    Console.WriteLine();
}

Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">👋 再见！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.ReadKey();</span></pre>
</div>
<h1 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>3 测试结果</span></span></h1>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>测试场景1</span></span></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>用户：<span>附近有什么好吃的餐厅？</span></span></span></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>调用链路：📱GetUserLocation → 🖥️SearchNearbyRestaurants</span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202602/381412-20260225172731030-801445898.gif" alt="agui-gif-demo-001" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>测试场景2</span></span></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>用户：根据我的偏好推荐餐厅</span></span></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>调用链路：📱GetUserPreferences → 📱GetUserLocation → 🖥️SearchNearbyRestaurants</span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202602/381412-20260225172744700-1349617727.gif" alt="agui-gif-demo-002" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>测试场景3</span></span></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>用户：烤匠这家店怎么样？</span></span></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>调用链路：🖥️GetRestaurantDetail</span></span></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202602/381412-20260225172809095-1411472636.gif" alt="agui-gif-demo-003" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></span></span></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>可以看到，Agent可以自动协调工具调用顺序，前后端工具能够实现协同工作，同时我们也能看到完整的工具调用链路。</span></span></p>
<h1 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span><strong><span>4 小结</span></strong></span></span></h1>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">本文介绍了AG-UI Tools即AG-UI的工具系统，演示了一个结合前后端工具使用的混合模式案例，通过案例可以了解如何在AG-UI中调用工具并观察调用链。</p>
